text:
oncall_alice: Paging — we're seeing a sustained spike in tail latency for requests routed to europe-west (p95 jumping from ~120ms to 650-900ms). Customers in EU report slow responses and some 504s. Alerting via APM + internal route-ops.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: routing-latency-spike-1767809123. Severity: sev2. Paging oncall_alice, netops_bob, sre_carmen. Runbook: routing/region-failures.md -> Step 1.

netops_bob: I'm looking at the routing policy layer (latency-based failover) — a recent rule change rolled at 09:02 UTC that lowered the latency threshold from 300ms -> 200ms. That could cause bounce to secondary region.

eng-runtime-dev: Confirmed a config push in control-plane at 09:02 from deploy pipeline: `latency_threshold_ms=200` for route-policy `latency-failover-eu`. Change set id: cfg_2026_03_15_902.

sre_carmen: Traffic graphs show ~12% of EU requests started sending to us-east-1 after the threshold flip. us-east has higher cross-region RTT so p95 spikes. Looks like the health signal used for latency is being double-counted (edge + origin) because of a metric merge bug.

oncall_alice: Is customer impact limited to a subset? Support_Dan can you confirm which customers are seeing 504s or errors?

support_dan: Quick list from support queue: two enterprise customers with EU-only configs, several PLG users reported slow UI. I've DM'd account owners, asking for logs.

pm_elaine: We're seeing elevated error budget burn for one high-revenue tenant. Sales notified. Prioritize mitigation.

netops_bob: Mitigation plan: 1) Roll back the latency_threshold change. 2) Add a temporary route pin for high-impact tenants to eu-west. 3) Retry policy on control-plane updates to avoid metric merge. Who can apply the pin?

eng-runtime-dev: I can push a route-override via admin CLI: `redwood route override create --scope tenant:ACME --region eu-west-1 --ttl 3600 --reason "temp pin after latency-policy flip"`

oncall_alice: Do it. Also add a global emergency override to keep 95% of EU-origin traffic in eu-west while we roll back. Use `--global-override` and set to 86400s.

eng-runtime-dev: Executing now. Output: ```
Override created: id=ovr_3421
Scope: global
Region: eu-west-1
TTL: 86400
Applied to routing layer: success
```

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: override ov r_3421 applied by eng-runtime-dev.

sre_carmen: After override, p95 in EU dropped back to ~130ms. 504s reduced. We're still seeing a small number of sticky sessions routing incorrectly due to DNS cache TTL.

netops_bob: TTLs for our region routing CNAME were 300s; some intermediate caches had longer effective TTLs. We can push a header-based routing override (X-Redwood-Force-Region) from edge to force eu-west for affected accounts as a follow-up. Need approval for edge header injection.

oncall_alice: Approve header injection for 1 hour. We should note auditing. Carmen, please coordinate with runtime to craft the header rule.

eng-runtime-dev: Implementing edge header rule: 
```
edge-rule apply --match "tenant in (ACME, BETA_CORP)" --set-header "X-Redwood-Force-Region: eu-west-1" --duration 3600
```
Applied.

support_dan: Confirmed ACME latency back to normal for recent requests. Support queue clearing. :thumbsup:

pm_elaine: Notifying impacted customers and sending an incident summary template. Keeping execs in loop.

sre_carmen: Root cause notes so far: 1) config change lowered latency threshold without gate, 2) metric merge bug caused inflated latency signal, 3) routing policy reacted and moved subset traffic cross-region, 4) DNS/cache TTLs caused lingering misroutes for some clients.

netops_bob: Next steps: revert cfg_2026_03_15_902, add guardrail on threshold changes (manual approval if delta > 50ms), ship fix for metric merge, increase observability: add a delta alert when >5% traffic moves region in 5m.

oncall_alice: I've reverted the config change. Waiting for control plane rollout confirmation.

eng-runtime-dev: Revert applied: `cfg_2026_03_15_902` rolled back. Control plane reports success. Monitoring p95 for 15m window.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: severity downgraded to sev3. Time to mitigation: 12m.

sre_carmen: Leaving oncall at 10:30 UTC — handing to netops_bob for remediation work and postmortem. Bob, take over.

netops_bob: Taking handoff. I'll drive the postmortem and remediation tickets: ROUTE-1423 (metric-merge-fix), ROUTE-1424 (threshold-guardrails), ROUTE-1425 (regional-override-audit).

oncall_alice: Thanks all. Add notes to incident tracker and tag affected customers. Postmortem owner: netops_bob.

pm_elaine: I'll draft the customer-facing timeline and include the emergency overrides we applied.

support_dan: closing support threads as customers confirmed recovery.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: routing-latency-spike-1767809123. Resolution summary: rollback of latency threshold + emergency region override + header injection mitigations. Postmortem assigned.

netops_bob: Will follow up with a draft postmortem in #incidents-pm within 24h. Closing thread here. :white_check_mark:
